methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This research aims to comprehensively evaluate and assess the performance of these standards in relation to both the LEED and BREEAM assessments.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Evaluates certification and rating-system criteria through an assessment matrix; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: To generate the most value from this evaluation, it was important to develop a method of comprehensively assessing each of these standards

stage1.notes: The restricted BREEAM Energy Model is mentioned only as an unavailable rating calculation; the paper does not present or characterise an EnPI/EnB model.
